artifact.title: Canonical Evolution and Change Control
artifact.purpose: Defines the normative rules governing the evolution of canonical AKS artifacts.

requirements.title: Explicit Change Authority
requirements.statement: Every proposed canonical change shall identify the governing authority responsible for the change.

requirements.title: Change Classification
requirements.statement: Every accepted change shall declare exactly one primary classification: Additive, Corrective, Clarifying, Deprecating, or Breaking.

requirements.title: Normative Intent
requirements.statement: Every change shall explicitly identify whether it modifies normative behavior, informative content, metadata, or organizational structure.

requirements.title: Compatibility Declaration
requirements.statement: Every accepted change shall declare whether it is Fully Compatible, Conditionally Compatible, or Breaking.

requirements.title: Dependency Impact Analysis
requirements.statement: Every proposed change shall identify all affected canonical artifacts before acceptance.

requirements.title: Architectural Integrity Review
requirements.statement: No accepted change may violate established architectural invariants unless those invariants are themselves evolved through governed change.

requirements.title: Mandatory Transition Preservation
requirements.statement: No accepted change is complete until every affected canonical artifact has been regenerated and preserved.

requirements.title: Historical Reconstruction
requirements.statement: Every revision shall preserve sufficient information to reconstruct its immediate predecessor.

requirements.title: Immutable Identity
requirements.statement: Revision shall never alter canonical identity; only versions evolve.

requirements.title: Deterministic Evolution
requirements.statement: Given the same prior canonical state and accepted change, independent conforming implementations shall produce equivalent canonical revisions.

derived_observations: Together they establish the AKS Core.

provenance.source: Architectural transition following completion of Foundation Package Alpha core ontology
